# Tatton Interiors

> Tatton Interiors is a UK interior fit-out subcontractor based in Altrincham, Greater Manchester. It prices and delivers plastering & drylining, metal stud partitions, suspended ceilings, commercial joinery and fitted furniture, internal glazing, and toilet cubicle and washroom packages for main contractors and fit-out firms, supply & fit or labour only, anywhere in the UK. It is the interiors subcontracting arm of Tatton Projects (main contractor) and part of the DPG Holdings group.

Key facts:
- Legal entity: Tatton Projects of Cheshire Limited (Companies House 17553626); Tatton Interiors is a trading name
- Group: DPG Holdings: Tatton Projects, Tatton Interiors, The Load Bearing Company, SiloPod, EstiMate
- Accreditations: Constructionline Gold, SSIP, CITB registered, CSCS-carded teams
- Founder: Dave Groom (20+ years: joiner, site manager, project manager, contracts manager)
- Contact: 0161 706 3880, info@tattoninteriors.co.uk, Suite 15, Peel House, 30 The Downs, Altrincham WA14 2PX
- Areas: UK-wide (England, Scotland, Wales), including London, Birmingham, Manchester, Liverpool, Leeds, Sheffield, Newcastle, Bristol, Nottingham, Glasgow, Cardiff, Cheshire

## Plastering & Drylining
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/plastering-drylining

Wall linings, independent linings, tape & joint and skim finishes for commercial fit-outs, refurbishments and new build. Priced as a package, delivered by our own supervised teams.

Scope:
- Dot & dab and direct-bond wall linings
- Independent wall linings (metal stud and I-stud)
- Shaftwall and stairwell linings
- Tape & joint to Q2–Q4 finish ready for decoration
- Hard-coat and skim plastering, patch & make good
- Fire-rated and acoustic linings to manufacturer systems
- Boarding to bulkheads, risers and boxing-in
- Making good after M&E first and second fix

We install to British Gypsum, Knauf and Siniat specifications, so the system on the drawings is the system that gets built and signed off.

Q: Do you price drylining labour only?
A: Yes. We price drylining and plastering packages either supply & fit or labour only where the main contractor free-issues boards and metal.

Q: What finish standard do you work to?
A: We tape & joint to the finish level in your specification, typically Q3 or Q4 for commercial areas, or hard-coat and skim where a plastered finish is specified.

Q: Can you work in occupied buildings?
A: Yes. Much of our fit-out work is in live offices and public buildings, phased around the client with dust control and out-of-hours working where needed.

## Partitions
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/partitions

Fire-rated, acoustic and standard metal stud partitions, set out, built and boarded to the system on your drawings, for office fit-outs, retail, healthcare and hospitality.

Scope:
- Metal stud partitions (GypWall, Knauf and Siniat systems)
- Fire-rated partitions to 30, 60 and 90 minutes
- Acoustic partitions with insulation and twin-frame build-ups
- Head deflection details and fire stopping at junctions
- Pattresses and noggins for wall-hung fittings
- Door openings, frames and ironmongery prep
- Toilet cubicles and IPS panel systems
- Acoustic wall panelling and feature walls

Partitions are set out from your drawings, built to the specified system and fire-stopped at the head, so they pass inspection first time.

Q: Can you build acoustic walls to a set sound rating?
A: Yes. We build acoustic partitions to the Rw rating in your specification, using the manufacturer system that achieves it: twin or staggered studs, acoustic insulation, double-layer acoustic board, sealed heads and junctions, and flanking details above the ceiling. We can arrange pre-completion sound testing.

Q: Do you install fire-rated partitions?
A: Yes. We build fire-rated partitions to the specified manufacturer system, including head deflection details and fire stopping at junctions and penetrations.

Q: Can you set out from drawings?
A: Yes. Our supervisors set out partition lines from your general arrangement and setting-out drawings and raise any clashes before boarding.

Q: Do you do partitions as a separate package?
A: Yes: partitions on their own, or combined with drylining, ceilings, joinery and glazing as one interiors package.

## Suspended Ceilings
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/suspended-ceilings

Exposed-grid and tile ceilings, MF plasterboard ceilings, bulkheads and acoustic rafts, installed level, coordinated with M&E and handed over clean.

Scope:
- Exposed grid and lay-in tile ceilings (600×600 / 1200×600)
- Metal and mesh feature ceiling tiles
- MF plasterboard ceilings and bulkheads
- Acoustic ceiling rafts and baffles
- Fire-rated ceilings and membranes
- Access panels and service hatches
- Coordination with lighting, diffusers and sprinkler drops
- Ceiling replacement in occupied buildings
- Perimeter trims and feature edges

Ceiling heights, grid setting-out and service positions are agreed up front, so the M&E trades fit around a ceiling that is already right.

Q: What types of suspended ceiling do you install?
A: Exposed-grid tile ceilings, concealed and MF plasterboard ceilings, bulkheads, acoustic rafts and fire-rated ceilings.

Q: Do you coordinate with M&E contractors?
A: Yes. We agree setting-out and service positions before install so lights, diffusers and sprinkler heads land in the grid.

Q: Can you replace ceilings in a live office?
A: Yes. We phase ceiling replacements around occupied floors and work out of hours where the client needs it.

## Joinery & Fitted Furniture
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/joinery

Timber slat and acoustic wall panelling, fitted booth seating, tea points and kitchenettes, bench desks, reception desks and doorsets, made and fitted by joiners who know commercial programmes.

Scope:
- Timber slat and acoustic felt wall panelling
- Fitted booth seating, banquettes and bench seating
- Tea points, kitchenettes and breakout kitchen runs
- Bench desks, touchdown points and work booths
- Reception desks and feature joinery
- Fire doorsets and ironmongery
- Retail shopfit joinery and display
- First and second fix, skirtings and architraves

Our founder came up through the tools as a joiner, so joinery packages are set out, fixed and finished to the standard the client sees first.

Q: Do you install fire doorsets?
A: Yes. We hang and ironmonger fire doorsets to the manufacturer installation instructions and keep the certification trail for handover.

Q: Do you make and fit fitted furniture?
A: Yes. We supply and fit booth seating, banquettes, tea points, bench desks, reception desks and wall panelling, or fit client-supplied furniture and joinery labour only.

Q: Do you do shopfitting joinery?
A: Yes. Our team has delivered brand-standard retail joinery for stores including Fossil and Calvin Klein.

## Internal Glazing
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/internal-glazing

Frameless and framed glass partitions, glazed meeting rooms and screens, glazed doors and crittall-style screens, installed plumb, sealed and manifested to spec.

Scope:
- Frameless single and double glazed partitions
- Framed aluminium glazed office screens
- Glass meeting rooms and boardrooms
- Glazed and frameless glass doors
- Crittall-style steel-look screens
- Acoustic glazing to specified dB ratings
- Manifestation and privacy film
- Integration with partitions and ceilings

Glazing is coordinated with the partition and ceiling packages, so heads, deflection and junctions are designed once rather than fixed on site.

Q: Do you install frameless glass partitions?
A: Yes. We install frameless single and double glazed partitions, glazed doors and meeting rooms, including acoustic-rated glazing.

Q: Can you do glazing with the partitions package?
A: Yes. Running glazing alongside partitions and ceilings means one team owns the junctions between them.

Q: Do you supply manifestation?
A: Yes. We supply and fit manifestation and privacy film to meet Building Regulations and the client brand.

## Toilet Cubicles & Washrooms
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/toilet-cubicles

Full-height and standard compact laminate cubicles, IPS framing and duct panels, vanity units and washroom fit-out, built around your plumbing and M&E so the washroom is ready to hand over.

Scope:
- Full-height and standard toilet cubicles in compact laminate (HPL)
- IPS framing and duct panels to conceal cisterns and pipework, with access panels
- Vanity units with solid-surface tops and undermount basin cut-outs
- Washroom wall panelling and IPS back panels
- Mirrors, dispensers and washroom accessories fitted
- Shower and changing room cubicles and benching
- Coordinated with plumbing and M&E first and second fix
- Washroom refurbishment in occupied buildings, phased floor by floor

IPS frames are set out and built before the plumber arrives, so cisterns, waste and supply pipework land where the panels and cubicles need them.

Q: Do you install toilet cubicles labour only?
A: Yes. We install client-supplied cubicles, IPS and vanities labour only, or supply and fit the full washroom package.

Q: Do you build the IPS framing?
A: Yes. We build the IPS framing at first fix, coordinate with the plumber for cisterns and pipework, then fit the duct panels, access panels and vanity tops at second fix.

Q: Can you refurbish washrooms in a building that stays open?
A: Yes. We phase washroom refurbishments floor by floor so the building always has working toilets, with temporary screening and out-of-hours noisy work where needed.

## Projects
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/projects

- Stockport service centre, Stockport (£175K): Phased fit-out of a live public service floor with 90+ staffed positions that never closed: suspended ceilings, acoustic dividers and screens.
- Sentric Music, Liverpool (£110K): Cat B office fit-out with feature ceiling raft, acoustic wall panelling, booths, boardroom and joinery.
- Office fit-out, Stockport (£125K): Compact office with frameless glass boardroom, oak flooring and a double-height stair.
- Office walkways & communal toilets, North West: Occupied office: new toilets, showers and changing rooms with stud framing, cubicle partitions and joinery.
- Calvin Klein, UK: Shell-to-store shopfit inside a live shopping centre: partitions, ceilings, joinery and shopfront glazing. Delivered by Dave Groom before founding Tatton Projects.
- Fossil, London: Brand-standard retail shopfit with illuminated walls, glazed display cases and joinery. Delivered by Dave Groom before founding Tatton Projects.
- Bar & restaurant, Leeds: Bar and restaurant with blackened steel screens, back bar and booth joinery. Delivered by Dave Groom before founding Tatton Projects.

## Areas
https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/areas

- London (London & the South East): the City, the West End, Canary Wharf, King's Cross and across the M25. London fit-outs run on tight logistics: restricted deliveries, booked goods lifts and out-of-hours working. We plan labour, material drops and accommodation around that from the start.
- Birmingham (the West Midlands): Birmingham city centre, Colmore Row, Digbeth, Solihull and the wider West Midlands. Birmingham is a short run down the M6 from our Altrincham base, so we can mobilise teams quickly and keep the same supervisor on your job from start to finish.
- Manchester (Greater Manchester): Manchester city centre, Spinningfields, Salford Quays, Trafford, Stockport and Altrincham. Manchester is home. Our office is in Altrincham, so for Greater Manchester packages there is no travel cost and the person who priced it is never far from site.
- Liverpool (Merseyside): Liverpool city centre, the Commercial District, the Baltic Triangle, the Knowledge Quarter and the Wirral. We have delivered Cat B office fit-out work in Liverpool, including the Sentric Music offices, and run Merseyside packages daily from our Altrincham base.
- Leeds (West Yorkshire): Leeds city centre, Wellington Place, Holbeck, Bradford and Wakefield. Leeds is just over the Pennines on the M62, so Yorkshire packages are run as day-commute jobs with the same supervised teams we use in Manchester.
- Sheffield (South Yorkshire): Sheffield city centre, Kelham Island, Meadowhall, Rotherham and Doncaster. South Yorkshire packages are run from Manchester over the Snake or the M62, with teams staying local for longer programmes.
- Newcastle (the North East): Newcastle city centre, Gateshead, Sunderland and Durham. For North East packages we mobilise a supervised team with local accommodation, so programme and quality are the same as on our home patch.
- Bristol (the South West): Bristol city centre, Temple Quarter, Harbourside, Bath and the M4/M5 corridor. South West packages are run with a resident supervised team and booked accommodation, priced up front so there are no travel extras later.
- Nottingham (the East Midlands): Nottingham, Derby, Leicester and the M1 corridor. The East Midlands is in easy reach of our base, so packages here are run with the same teams and supervision as our North West work.
- Glasgow (Scotland): Glasgow city centre, the IFSD, Edinburgh and the Central Belt. For Scottish packages we bring a supervised team with accommodation booked, working to the same systems and records as in England.
- Cardiff (South Wales): Cardiff city centre, Swansea, Newport and the M4 corridor. South Wales packages are run with a resident supervised team, with travel and accommodation priced in from the start.
- Cheshire (Cheshire): Chester, Warrington, Knutsford, Wilmslow, Macclesfield and Crewe. Cheshire is on our doorstep, with our office in Altrincham, so Cheshire packages carry no travel costs and quick call-outs for snagging.

## Common questions

Q: What does Tatton Interiors do?
A: Tatton Interiors is an interior fit-out subcontractor. We price and deliver plastering and drylining, metal stud partitions, suspended ceilings, joinery and fitted furniture, internal glazing, and toilet cubicle and washroom packages for main contractors and fit-out firms.

Q: Do you work supply & fit or labour only?
A: Both. Every package can be priced supply & fit with materials included, or labour only where the main contractor free-issues materials.

Q: Where do you work?
A: Anywhere in the UK. We are based in Altrincham, Greater Manchester, and take packages across England, Scotland and Wales, including London, Birmingham, Manchester, Liverpool, Leeds, Sheffield, Newcastle, Bristol, Nottingham, Glasgow and Cardiff. For work away we bring supervised teams with accommodation priced in.

Q: How is Tatton Interiors related to Tatton Projects?
A: Tatton Interiors is the interiors subcontracting arm of Tatton Projects. It is a trading name of Tatton Projects of Cheshire Limited and part of the DPG Holdings group. Tatton Projects delivers main contracts; Tatton Interiors delivers interior packages for other contractors.

Q: Are you pre-qualified?
A: Yes. We hold Constructionline Gold and SSIP accreditation, are CITB registered, and our site teams are CSCS carded. We will complete your PQQ or supplier forms.

Q: Who owns Tatton Interiors?
A: Tatton Interiors is a trading name of Tatton Projects of Cheshire Limited (company no. 17553626), part of the DPG Holdings group, run by founder Dave Groom.

Q: What accreditations do you hold?
A: Constructionline Gold and SSIP accreditation, CITB registration, and CSCS-carded site teams.
